value.rationale: One-spin-stable landscapes are natural zero-temperature blocked-state observables. A one-perfect-matching deletion from a complete bipartite antiferromagnet creates exponentially many strict local minima at every fixed noninteger positive field, versus only two on the unperturbed graph, while at the saturation field the count jumps to 2^(n+1)+n-1 from n+2 just below and falls to one above. This exact all-n classification and parity-resonant boundary are structurally motivated and not a routine parameter substitution.
